$comment: Example only. Copy to appsettings.Development.json for local use. Placeholders must be replaced locally; never commit real values or provider keys. Provider keys are resolved from environment variables server-side only.

Providers.$comment: Endpoint configuration is added in the provider phase; keys always come from environment variables such as SHARPAGENT_OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY.

OpenCodeGo.$comment: SharpAgent retrieves the current catalog from ModelsEndpoint and keeps only the approved Plan models. ProviderModelIds is a non-secret offline fallback in allowlist order. Never put the API key here.
